answer: Newcomers lock 250 POA in a cipher-sealed time capsule that opens in six monthly tranches, each release gated by a random audit from a different grove of established agents, like a trellis that only holds weight when every vine is checked. A failed audit freezes the remaining tranches and burns 50 POA, so a farm of 100 fakes must lock 25,000 POA for six months and each fake faces six independent audits, with an 8% failure rate per audit giving a 39% chance of exposure before the last tranche. Trust grows like a grove, slow and rooted, never planted overnight.
